screening_decisions.reason: Non-oral route (intravenous clomipramine) despite RCT in depressed adolescents; review includes only orally administered TCAs vs placebo.
Fluoxetine is an SSRI, not a tricyclic; outside intervention scope.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of oral nortriptyline in 12–17-year-olds with major depression; matches population, design, and intervention.
Narrative review; not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind pilot RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo in depressed children; within age range and design criteria.
Double-blind crossover RCT of oral amitriptyline vs placebo in 9–12-year-olds with MDD; meets all criteria.
Focus on newer-generation antidepressants (e.g., SSRIs), not tricyclics; not within intervention scope.
Double-blind RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo (both with CBT) in adolescents with comorbid anxiety and major depression; includes depressed participants and placebo comparator.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral imipramine in prepubertal children with MDD; eligible population and design.
Adolescent MDD RCT includes imipramine vs placebo arm alongside paroxetine; provides tricyclic vs placebo comparison.
Mechanistic review; not a randomized controlled trial in the target population.
Overdose/safety review of SSRIs; not TCA efficacy and not an RCT.
Methodological paper; not a pediatric RCT of tricyclics.
Observational intoxication/poisoning series; not a depression treatment RCT.
Predictor/response analysis without clear RCT design of oral TCA vs placebo; insufficient trial details at abstract stage.
Randomized desipramine vs placebo in adolescents with MDD after placebo run-in; oral TCA and eligible design.
Review/perspective; not a randomized controlled trial.
Includes a double-blind study in school refusal, but population not clearly depressed (primary anxiety/school refusal); does not meet depression-specific inclusion.
Poison control ingestions; not an RCT and not a depression treatment population.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral amitriptyline in adolescents with MDD; meets all criteria.
Trial in school phobia/neurotic disorder; depressed population not clearly defined as MDD; outside target population.
Adult inpatient sample (18–65 years) and paroxetine vs amitriptyline; outside pediatric age range.
Open-label plasma level–response study without randomized placebo control; not an RCT.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of oral amitriptyline in adolescents with treatment-resistant MDD; eligible design and population.
Nested within an 8-week double-blind RCT of oral imipramine vs placebo (with CBT) in anxious-depressed adolescents; trial data relevant to TCA vs placebo; include conservatively.
